questions.title: Define the Random Variable - Name X and list the values it can take in a described situation
Legitimate Distribution Check - Apply the two characteristics to a candidate table
Complete the PDF Table - Use sum-to-1 to find the missing probability, then read P(X >= k) off the finished table
Turn Counts into a PDF - Convert a table of counts to probabilities, read P(X = k) and P(X <= k), name the most likely value
Read Probabilities off a Distribution Table - P(x = k), P(x > k) and P(x >= k) as row sums
Read Less-Than Probabilities off a Distribution Table - P(x < k) and P(x <= k) as row sums
Which Rows to Add - Range and at-least-one probabilities off a full distribution table, and which rows an inequality selects
Build a PDF Table from a Description - recover the buried probability, then read P(X <= 1) off the table
Pre-FRQ Grade a Built Distribution - the scenario and grading checklist of the build-a-distribution FRQ, but the student grades four sample responses against the rubric instead of writing one
